verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The resume loop remains fail-closed while becoming convergent: a nonzero enable is accepted only after a fresh workflow-state read returns exactly `active`; unreadable, `disabled_manually`, and `disabled_inactivity` states remain fatal, and all four writers are still attempted. The fake now accurately models GitHub CLI's disabled-only enable resolution and clears both manual and inactivity-disabled state on success. The added cases independently exercise the successful disabled-to-active path, the already-active selector miss, transient failure, inactive states, missing write/read grants, exact call order, and final state, so the new acceptance path is non-vacuous. I found no correctness, security, or completeness issue. With no findings in either round, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
